derivation.method: Authored from the pinned Steel Compendium only (canonical checkout at the main repo vendor/steel-compendium, HEAD fb83a789 verified with git rev-parse; sha256 recorded per source). Level-one baselines and record naming copied from tests/fixtures/v106-beastheart-expected.json (reviewed) and docs/build/audits/V106-beastheart-rules-review.md. No evaluator, content, convex or headless code read or run.
derivation.staminaMaximum: Beastheart Basics: Starting Stamina 21 + 12 per level after 1st; kit Stamina bonus per echelon (kit files: Shining Armor +12, Cloak and Dagger +3, Panther +6, Sniper none); levels 1-3 are echelon 1 (rule/general/echelon.md "1st Echelon (1st to 3rd Level)"). Matches V106 level-one values 33/24/27/21.
derivation.recoveryValue: floor(Stamina maximum / 3) (rule/health/recoveries.md "one-third of their Stamina maximum, rounded down")
derivation.recoveriesMaximum: Beastheart Basics: 12; unchanged at levels 2-3. Companion has no Recoveries (companion-rules.md).
derivation.companionStaminaMaximum: companion-rules.md: "Your companion's Stamina maximum equals your Stamina maximum." No second kit addition (V106).
derivation.potency: Beastheart Basics: weak Might - 2, average Might - 1, strong Might; every witness has Might 2 -> 0/1/2.
derivation.noNumericSheetChange: No level-2 or level-3 feature, chosen ability, companion level-3 feature or chosen perk changes recoveries, speed, stability, disengage, characteristics or potency. Characteristic Increase first appears at 4th level; the Rampage table adds nothing at levels 2-3.
derivation.abilityCounts: Advancement table: level 2 adds one 5-Ferocity wild nature ability (Wild Nature Abilities 5); level 3 adds one 7-Ferocity ability (Abilities Signature, 3, 5, 7) and the companion's level 3 feature.
derivation.performers: companion-rules.md Shared Abilities: Beastheart keyword -> beastheart only; Companion keyword -> companion only; otherwise the granting text decides (V106 gives both performers to "you or your companion" actions). All eight 2nd-level wild nature abilities have the Companion keyword; all four 7-Ferocity abilities have the Beastheart keyword; This One's Yours has no keyword and its feature says "you or your companion".
derivation.recordConvention: V106: "<Performer>: <Ability>" at the printed cost (0 when none); each printed "Spend N Ferocity" option is "<Performer>: <Ability>: Spend option K (N Ferocity)" under the same performer; species traits that are not sheet numbers are "Companion: <Trait>" at 0.
derivation.choices: Nature ability alternates alphabetically within each wild nature in witness order; ability7 cycles Death and Violence, Head to Head, Jaws of Death, Shieldbreaker in witness order; perks are distinct, from the three level-2 groups, not already held (all bases hold Teamwork), no sub-choice, and grant no action.

uncertainties.passage: en/unified/md/feature/beastheart/level-2/2nd-level-wild-nature-ability.md: the four "2nd-Level <Nature> Abilities" sections contain only "Choose one of the following abilities." with no list.
uncertainties.resolution: Pairs derived from each ability file's subclass: frontmatter: guardian Fetch!/Omnomnom; prowler Jump Scare/On You Like Your Shadow; punisher Foe Bowling/One Roar and We're Back In the Fight; spark Burning Lash/Howling Gale. Every pair is two 5-Ferocity heroic abilities, consistent with the advancement table. Single source only (no Beastheart book text in the pinned books/).
alternatives: none available in the pinned Compendium

uncertainties.passage: en/unified/md/feature/ability/beastheart/level-2/this-ones-yours.md has subclass: punisher, no cost; feature/beastheart/level-2/this-ones-yours.md: "Once per turn, you or your companion can use the following free triggered action."
uncertainties.resolution: Excluded from the Punisher choice pair; granted to every Punisher at level 2 by the wild nature feature.
alternatives: treat as a third Punisher choice option (rejected: the choice is "one of two heroic abilities" and it has no Ferocity cost)

uncertainties.passage: Ability frontmatter action_type "Triggered Action"; feature text and spend text call it a "free triggered action"; spend text "You and your companions can each use this free triggered action on the same turn."
uncertainties.resolution: Treated as a free triggered action (does not consume the shared one-triggered-action-per-round budget in companion-rules.md), once per turn; spend option lets the partner also use it that turn. "companions" plural read as the single companion. Recorded for both performers, each with Spend option 1 (1 Ferocity).
alternatives: a non-free triggered action consuming the shared per-round triggered action
spend option recorded once rather than per performer

uncertainties.passage: burning-lash.md (Companion keyword): "Spend 1 Ferocity: If you are within distance of the target, you can use a free maneuver to wield a second whip..."; companion-rules.md defines "you"/"partner" only for abilities either can use.
uncertainties.resolution: Record kept under the parent performer as "Companion: Burning Lash: Spend option 1 (1 Ferocity)" per V106 convention (Bring the Thunder's "2 burst originating from you" is also recorded under Companion). Who the "you" wielding the second whip is stays manual.
alternatives: "you" is the beastheart (default meaning of "you" in class text), making the free maneuver the beastheart's
"you" is the companion as the ability user

uncertainties.passage: watchdog.md "You and your companion can't be surprised."; supersniffer.md "While a creature is adjacent to your companion, that creature can't be hidden or have concealment from your companion."; stormheart.md "...you can change the damage type..."; everyones-best-friend.md "Once per round during a montage test ... your companion can increase the tier outcome by one tier".
uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION: Watchdog, Supersniffer and Stormheart get no record (features only): passive or an in-resolution damage-type option, with no action, cost or frequency limit; the V106 record-every-situational-trait precedent covered companion species traits, while passive class rules (Shared Space, Shared Skills) got no record. Everyone's Best Friend gets "Companion: Everyone's Best Friend" (0) because it is a discretionary, once-per-round use, like V106's Communicate / Use treasure for companion.
alternatives: record Stormheart for both performers ("Beastheart: Stormheart", "Companion: Stormheart", 0) as a situational trigger like Electric Surge
no record for Everyone's Best Friend (montage-only, outside combat tracking)

uncertainties.passage: endless-breath.md "The drake's Drake Breath maneuver deals an extra 2 damage."
uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION: recorded as "Companion: Endless Breath" (0), like V106 situational species traits; it is not a sheet number and Drake Breath damage is manual.
alternatives: no separate record; +2 folded into the Drake Breath record text/damage

uncertainties.passage: All level-3 companion features except Endless Breath apply "while rampaging"; rampage.md: rampaging at 8 rampage.
uncertainties.resolution: Rampage stays manual (V106), so these are 0-cost manual records; Greased Pig's +2 speed is conditional and not a sheet speed change.

uncertainties.passage: Beastheart-book perks Born Tracker, People Sense, Ride Along, Trained Thief, Voice of the Wild, Wild Rumpus, Wilds Explorer, You Can Pet Them, They're Friendly (scc mcdm.beastheart.v1/perk/*) have no group in their files or in _index/perk.md; the Heroes book groups only core perks.
uncertainties.resolution: Excluded from eligibleCorePerks and not chosen. Their eligibility for "one exploration, interpersonal, or intrigue perk" is undetermined by the pinned Compendium.
alternatives: admit them by apparent theme (e.g. Born Tracker/Wilds Explorer exploration, People Sense/You Can Pet Them interpersonal, Trained Thief intrigue)

uncertainties.passage: companion-rules.md Shared Perks: "If you gain a benefit ... by earning a perk ... your companion shares the benefit ... only ... benefits ... that logically affect an animal".
uncertainties.resolution: Chosen perks change no sheet number for hero or companion; applicability to the companion is a Director call and stays manual.

uncertainties.passage: class/beastheart.md advancement table prints "Everyone’s Best Friend" and "This One’s Yours" (curly); feature/ability frontmatter names use straight apostrophes; "Fetch!" includes the exclamation mark.
uncertainties.resolution: Record names use the frontmatter names with straight apostrophes.
alternatives: curly apostrophes as in the advancement table

uncertainties.passage: death-and-violence.md Trigger "Your companion uses an ability that reduces the target to 0 Stamina." (Beastheart keyword); companion-rules.md "You can use one triggered action per round, which can be used by either you or your companion."
uncertainties.resolution: Beastheart performs; the shared per-round triggered action budget is manual.

commonFeatures.name: Perk
commonFeatures.choice: one exploration, interpersonal, or intrigue perk
commonFeatures.textVerbatim: You gain one exploration, interpersonal, or intrigue perk of your choice.

commonFeatures.name: Everyone's Best Friend
commonFeatures.textVerbatim: Your companion may not be much of a talker, but they've got a lifetime of experience surviving the dangers of the wild. They can offer aid in nearly any circumstance: helping exhausted travelers find their way, leading panicked villagers out of a burning building, or even providing a comforting nuzzle at just the right time. Once per round during a montage test, when you or another character makes a test, your companion can increase the tier outcome by one tier (to a maximum of tier 3).
commonFeatures.performerDecision: "your companion can increase the tier outcome by one tier" -> Companion only. Record because it is a discretionary use with a frequency limit ("Once per round during a montage test"), like V106's discretionary records (Communicate, Use treasure for companion). See uncertainty level-two-feature-records.

commonFeatures.name: 2nd-Level Wild Nature Feature
commonFeatures.grants: one feature per wild nature (2nd-Level Wild Nature Features table)

commonFeatures.name: 2nd-Level Wild Nature Ability
commonFeatures.choice: "Your wild nature grants your choice of one of two heroic abilities." Cost 5 per advancement-table Wild Nature Abilities column "5".
commonFeatures.groupingSource: The unified file's four per-nature sections ("Choose one of the following abilities.") are EMPTY. Pairs derived from the subclass: frontmatter of each file in en/unified/md/feature/ability/beastheart/level-2/. No second source: the pinned books/ directory contains only heroes/, not the Beastheart book.

Guardian.name: Watchdog
Guardian.textVerbatim: You and your companion can't be surprised.
Guardian.recordDecision: NONE: purely passive state ("can't be surprised") with no action, trigger choice, cost or frequency to record; not a species trait, so the V106 species-trait record precedent does not reach it. Surprise handling is manual.

Prowler.name: Supersniffer
Prowler.textVerbatim: While a creature is adjacent to your companion, that creature can't be hidden or have concealment from your companion.
Prowler.recordDecision: NONE: purely passive restriction on hidden/concealment adjacent to the companion; no action, choice, cost or frequency; class feature, not a species trait.

Punisher.name: This One's Yours
Punisher.textVerbatim: Once per turn, you or your companion can use the following free triggered action.
Punisher.recordDecision: RECORDS: grants the free triggered action This One's Yours usable by "you or your companion" -> Beastheart and Companion records plus each performer's Spend option 1 (1 Ferocity).

Spark.name: Stormheart
Spark.textVerbatim: Whenever you or your companion deals cold, fire, lightning, sonic, or untyped damage, you can change the damage type to cold, fire, lightning, or sonic damage.
Spark.recordDecision: NONE (interpretation, see uncertainty level-two-feature-records): an optional damage-type substitution applied inside the resolution of other damage; no action, cost or frequency limit of its own.

Punisher.name: One Roar and We're Back In the Fight

levelThree.sourceAdvancementTable: en/unified/md/class/beastheart.md (row 3rd: Companion Advancement Feature, 7-Ferocity Ability; Abilities Signature, 3, 5, 7; Wild Nature Abilities 5)

automaticFeatures.name: Companion Advancement Feature
automaticFeatures.textVerbatim: Your companion gains the level 3 advancement feature granted by their stat block.

automaticFeatures.name: 7-Ferocity Ability
automaticFeatures.textVerbatim: Choose one heroic ability from the following options, each of which costs 7 ferocity to use.
automaticFeatures.groupingSource: The unified 7-ferocity file lists no options; options are the four files in en/unified/md/feature/ability/beastheart/level-3/ (all level: "3", cost: 7 Ferocity, no subclass).

Basilisk.name: Foes Forever Frozen
Basilisk.textVerbatim: Whenever the basilisk makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, the target is stoned (save ends).

Bear.name: Foe Thresher
Bear.textVerbatim: Whenever the bear targets a creature with a strike that doesn't impose [forced movement](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) while rampaging, the bear can push the target up to a number of squares equal to the bear's Might score.

Boar.name: Greased Pig
Boar.textVerbatim: While the boar is rampaging, they have a +2 bonus to speed and a double edge on the Escape Grab maneuver.
Boar.recordNote: +2 speed applies only while rampaging (Rampage is manual in V106), so it is not a sheet speed change.

Condor.name: Dive Bomb
Condor.textVerbatim: Whenever the condor makes a strike while rampaging, they deal extra damage equal to the number of squares they've moved on their turn (to a maximum of 5).

Deinonychus.name: Tear You to Ribbons
Deinonychus.textVerbatim: Whenever the deinonychus makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, the target is [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding) until the end of their next turn.

Drake.name: Endless Breath
Drake.textVerbatim: The drake's Drake Breath maneuver deals an extra 2 damage.
Drake.recordNote: Interpretation: recorded like V106's situational species traits; alternative is folding +2 into the manual Drake Breath record text (uncertainty endless-breath-record).

Elemental Spark.name: Electroshock
Elemental Spark.textVerbatim: Whenever the spark makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, they can cause a target who has M < AVERAGE to be [dazed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/dazed) until the end of the target's next turn.

Gummy Ball.name: Suck It Up
Gummy Ball.textVerbatim: Whenever the ball makes a strike while rampaging, one target is pulled up to 3 squares into the ball's space. If the target ends this movement and completely fits within the ball's space, the target is [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) by the ball.

Hellhound.name: Infernal Apparition
Hellhound.textVerbatim: Whenever the hellhound makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, they can cause a target who has P < AVERAGE to be [frightened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/frightened) until the end of the target's next turn.

Lightbender.name: Hit and Run
Lightbender.textVerbatim: Whenever the lightbender makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, the lightbender can [teleport](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport) up to 5 squares and use the [Hide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.intrigue/hide) maneuver.

Panther.name: Cat and Mouse
Panther.textVerbatim: Whenever the panther makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, the panther can knock the target [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone).

Spider.name: Dripping Fangs
Spider.textVerbatim: Whenever the spider makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, the spider can deal extra poison damage equal to their Might score.

Sporeling.name: Slowing Spores
Sporeling.textVerbatim: Whenever the sporeling makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, the sporeling can cause the target to be [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed) until the end of the target's next turn.

Wolf.name: My, What Big Teeth You Have
Wolf.textVerbatim: Whenever the wolf makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, they can grab the target.
